== Summary ==
Players at a table, posted by Shadow 14 on 18 October 2019 in the announcement thread for the [[2019 Tilburg Star Wars CCG weekend|Star Wars CCG weekend in Tilburg, Netherlands]] (9–10 November 2019). The post does not name them or say when the photograph was taken.

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1277719#p1277719 post 1277719] in topic 73718 (Star Wars CCG in Tilburg 9/10th November), by Shadow 14, 2019-10-18. Forum attachment id 9592.jpg (71251120_10215035713066609_3604604586532274176_n - Kopie.jpg).
* '''Posted by:''' Shadow 14
